title: ADC AC Measurement
text: Measure AC performance metrics of ADC output, 3 inputs, {Analog stimulus frequency (Hz)} sets Frequency of the analog input signal to ADC positive real scalar; {Distortion measurement type} sets the type of distortion, {Spectrum estimation method}, {Resolution bandwidth (Hz)} sets the resolution bandwidth positive, {Start conversion frequency (Hz)} sets the frequency of the start conversion clock of the ADC, {Hold off time (s)} sets the delays measurement analysis to avoid corruption, {Recommended min. simulation stop time (s)} sets the minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result positive real, {Set as model stop time} sets the automatically set recommended min. simulation stop time as model stop time, {Output result to base workspace} sets the store detailed test results to base, {Workspace variable name} sets the name of the variable that stores detailed test results and {Show spectrum analyzer during simulation} sets the displays spectrum analyzer during. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: digital
ports.summary: Converted digital signal from ADC scalar

ports.name: ready
ports.summary: Indicates whether analog to digital conversion is complete scalar

params.name: Distortion measurement type
params.values: Type of distortion to measure Harmonic (default) | Intermodulation

params.name: Analog stimulus frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of the analog input signal to ADC positive real scalar | positive real valued vector

params.name: Spectrum estimation method
params.values: Spectrum estimation method Welch (default) | Filter bank

params.name: Start conversion frequency (Hz)
params.values: Frequency of the start conversion clock of the ADC 1e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Hold off time (s)
params.values: Delays measurement analysis to avoid corruption by transients 0 (default) | nonnegative real scalar

params.name: Recommended min. simulation stop time (s)
params.values: Minimum time simulation must run for meaningful result positive real scalar

params.name: Set as model stop time
params.values: Automatically set recommended min. simulation stop time as model stop time button

params.name: Output result to base workspace
params.values: Store detailed test results to base workspace off (default) | on

params.name: Workspace variable name
params.values: Name of the variable that stores detailed test results adc_ac_out (default) | character string

params.name: Show spectrum analyzer during simulation
params.values: Displays spectrum analyzer during simulation off (default) | on
